description:
Namespaces for a Spring Boot server: the ThreadBoundScope every store
        routes by, the namespace repository (file or Postgres, following
        mindconnect.persistence), the NamespaceService, and the two servlet
        filters that choose the namespace of a request — from a /ns/{namespace}/
        path prefix, an X-Mindconnect-Namespace header, or the namespace the
        user selected in the browser session — and bind it to the thread.
